title: Gorbachev says various civilizations have made contact

tellings.quote: And then when we talked with the former president of the Soviet Union, Mikail Gorbachov, he also spoke about the fact that there are various civilizations that have made contact with representatives of our earth.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, a Russian politician presented on a podcast as a former president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, recalls a conversation from the 1990s. He says that Mikhail Gorbachev, the former president of the Soviet Union, told them that various civilizations have made contact with people on Earth. If true, it would mean a former Soviet leader believed contact had already happened.
